mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (conversation_id, user_id, title) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{title})
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, status, TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, TO_CHAR(update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, status, TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, TO_CHAR(update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time FROM conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET update_time = now() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
